long_biography.plain_text:
Trevor Johnston was running a North Vancouver creative agency when clinic owner Alison Taylor asked him to help brand and launch her new practice. Her difficulty finding software that fitted a multidisciplinary clinic prompted him to build an online booking and charting tool. After other practitioners began asking for it, the pair developed billing features and turned the in-house system into Jane App, launching it more widely in 2014.

Johnston became the product and development lead while Taylor brought the clinic owner's perspective to the company. Jane grew through referrals into a platform used by many private health practices for scheduling, records, billing and patient communications. The co-founders have continued to run it together; outside investors later backed the profitable software business. Public financing reports describe a substantial company valuation, but they do not reveal Johnston's personal shareholding, proceeds or net worth.
